conditions: Installed browsers and warm npm/OS caches. Every invocation runs npm ci and rebuilds all selected apps; no build artifact cache or snapshots. Timings include selection, install, tasks and cleanup. Deployment is separate. Two successful runs are not a p95 guarantee.

coverage.ci: Shared/account/offline/diagnostics/music units and contracts, DoReGo and SongAlong units, Soundglow selected unit/DSP checks, all four builds/type checks, Chromium playback/MIDI/audio-lifecycle/guitar checks, all four desktop/phone WebKit startup and auth-confirm isolation checks.
coverage.nightly: Every former CI and Nightly command plus current CI commands; exhaustive editions and real Accounts integration on Chromium and WebKit.
